reason: I am not buying a big machine in an ordinary week at full price. Hand-washing costs us nothing, and if I buy a washer at all it will be at the harvest or for a wedding in the family, when the dealer gives a discount or a free gift.
objection: ₹22,000, or ₹28,500 with the solar panel, is a lot for something we already do by hand for free. And will the battery really last, and will the dealer actually come out and fix it in the village?
would_change_my_mind: A festival offer from my local dealer: a clear discount, or the solar panel thrown in free, plus a YouTube video of someone in a village like mine showing it finishing a load during a power cut.
